_meta.purpose: Master marketing-occasions calendar for the Social Content Tool (Tab 3 planner). Evergreen / annual - reused every year. The tool shows these for the chosen month, the owner ticks which to use, and each ticked occasion suggests products by matching 'match.rooms' / 'match.styles' to the product TAGS pulled from Shopify (via the tool backend). Days with no ticked occasion get a random unused product with room-rotation.

fields.name: display name
fields.date2026: concrete date this year (MM-DD) or empty for a window/season
fields.window: content lead-up range {start,end} MM-DD - when to post around it
fields.rule: how the date is worked out for movable dates (owner confirms exact day)
fields.relevance: why it sells wall art / the angle
fields.match: { rooms:[], styles:[] } - matched against product tags to suggest products
fields.promoSuggested: true if this occasion usually warrants a discount code

_meta.note: rooms/styles are matched to the owner's real Shopify product tags - align this vocab to her actual tags when wiring the tool.
